chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Israil, from Al-Reza (peace be upon him) who said:

Scrofula (an illness of the neck) came out with a slave girl of ours in her neck. So a man came to me and said: 'O Ali! Say to her that she should say, O Kind! O Merciful! O Lord! O my Master!', repeating it. He said: 'So she said it, and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, removed it from her.' He said: 'And he said: This is the supplication which Ja'far Bin Suleyman supplicated with.'

key_terms.جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ: Ja'far Bin Suleyman; a companion known for using this supplication
key_terms.خَنَازِيرُ: Scrofula; a disease of the neck characterized by swollen glands
key_terms.يَا رَءُوفُ: O Kind/Compassionate; an attribute of God
key_terms.يَا رَبِّ: O Lord; addressing God as the Sustainer
key_terms.يَا رَحِيمُ: O Merciful; an attribute of God
key_terms.يَا سَيِّدِي: O my Master; addressing God as the Owner/Controller

ai.seo_question: What is the specific supplication for removing scrofula or neck ailments according to Imam Al-Reza?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) narrates that a slave girl suffered from scrofula (خَنَازِير) in her neck. He instructed her to repeatedly recite a specific supplication invoking Allah's kindness, mercy, lordship, and mastership, which resulted in the removal of the illness. He identifies this as the same supplication used by Ja'far Bin Suleyman.
